title: JHHE
description: A Minecraft survival server inspired by the chaos and freedom of 2b2t. There are almost no rules,every player is free to explore, build, destroy, or survive however they want.
body:
Welcome to a high-freedom Minecraft survival server inspired by the legendary anarchy gameplay of 2b2t.

This server offers a true sandbox experience where players create the story of the world themselves.

Features

🌍 Shared Persistent World
A long-running world where everything built by players becomes part of the server's history.

⚔️ Almost No Rules (Anarchy Style)
No land claims, no protection systems, and minimal admin interference.

🏗️ Unlimited Building Freedom
Build massive cities, hidden bases, underground bunkers, or anything you can imagine.

💥 True Survival Environment
Your base might be discovered, destroyed, or taken over by other players.

🕰️ Player-Driven History
Every structure, ruin, and conflict tells the story of past players.

Whether you choose to build an empire, explore the world, form alliances, or simply survive the chaos — the choice is entirely yours.

⚠️ This server requires a legitimate (premium) Minecraft account to join.
